title: Double wall stainless mug
text: Double wall stainless mug. Bought two, one black one stainless for husband and I - road trip.  Each morning we filled with ice and then topped with water... the cups kept the water and ice EASILY through 10 hours - some of which was in a hot, parked truck.  I hand washed them.. although you may be able to put in the dishwasher, top rack.  The lids have a tiny hole and the the slot for drinking.  I have a different style lid on another cup that has a "slide" to help stop spills... to be honest that lid sucks.  SUPER hard to clean and get the soap out of. These lids rocked!  Easy to clean and stayed put.  Of course, if you do tip them over, they will leak.  I recommend keeping them upright no matter what lid you have.  :)  They are not super heavy... they do seem to be double walled as they kept the ice in the glass easily to the end of the day.  Oh, and they are narrower at the bottom, as shown in the photo, so they fit into cup holders easily.  I would totally buy these again and feel comfortable recommending them. Just fyi... I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful or that would change my review.
